Get multiple hash lists at once.
operation.description: Get multiple hash lists at once. It is very common for a client to need to get multiple hash lists. Using this method is preferred over using the regular Get method multiple times. This is a standard batch Get method as defined by https://google.aip.dev/231 and the HTTP method is also GET.

operation.summary: Get the latest contents of a hash list.
operation.description: Get the latest contents of a hash list. A hash list may either by a threat list or a non-threat list such as the Global Cache. This is a standard Get method as defined by https://google.aip.dev/131 and the HTTP method is also GET.

List hash lists. In the V5 API, Google will never remove a hash list that has ever been returned by this method. This enables clients to skip using this method and simply hard-code all hash lists they need. This is a standard List method as defined by https://google.aip.dev/132 and the HTTP method is GET.

operation.description: Searches for URLs matching known threats. Each URL and it's host-suffix and path-prefix expressions (up to a limited depth) are checked. This means that the response may contain URLs that were not included in the request, but are expressions of the requested URLs.
